answer: Cap new identities per epoch and auction the licences: only a fixed number are issued each epoch, sold to the highest bidders, and each expires unless renewed by clean trading. A lone agent can afford one at its normal price, but a Sybil attacker needing hundreds must bid against every real newcomer, pushing the price toward its zenith. Like a cedar grove admitting only so many saplings, the cap makes mass fakery pay a rising market price per fake, while the kernel of the rule - scarce, expiring, publicly auctioned entry - needs no trusted gatekeeper.
